title: Translation freshness tracking
summary: Compare Markdown and locale UI keys with a source locale, emit a non-blocking report and accept reviewed hashes through a stale-safe plan.
invariants: Tracking does not change locale routing, fallback or missing-page policy.
Status and build never edit Markdown or the translation lock.
Different page paths require an identical explicit translation_key.
Fallback use is visible and is not a completed translation.
Acceptance is hash-bound and distinguishes ai_verified from human_reviewed.
